operation.summary: Replace custom mode definitions; create, rename or remove unused custom modes; [] clears them. Built-in modes and the current mode cannot be removed. Needs App settings and Agent Super Powers

body.name: custom
body.description: Complete replacement list, at most 8 unique names, 1-24 letters/digits/underscore starting with a letter; spaces normalize to underscores; built-in names refused

operation.returns: modes, custom, mode, since, set_by, log

custom.description: Complete replacement list, at most 8 unique names, 1-24 letters/digits/underscore starting with a letter; spaces normalize to underscores; built-in names refused

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
